g.text: Figure 7 | Complete functional hierarchy: cue classes, subtypes, heatmaps and prototypes

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616f

g.text: All cue-aligned graphs from the Functional hierarchy section are retained; only typography, spacing and panel hierarchy change.

text.style: font-size: 6.45px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: A, average-linkage clustering of trial-mean cue profiles with the original leaf order, region/class strips, class traces and regional composition. B, the original 16-subtype order with end-to-end bootstrap stability,

text.style: font-size: 6.45px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: rate and n. C, every supplied cluster is row-z-scored once over −1 to +5 s and ordered by major class, subtype and peak time; all panels share −2 to +4 z. D, all 16 subtype prototypes share one firing-rate scale. Classes

text.style: font-size: 6.45px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: and subtypes are functional response motifs from one recording, not validated cell types; the four-cluster C2 class remains visibly fragile.
